run_kilt_zsre_main: run the Kilt_ZSRE main function to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_kilt_zsre_dataset: create a Kilt_ZSRE dataset instance to load and preprocess the KILT zero-shot relation extraction task
load_kilt_dataset: load the kilt_tasks structured_zeroshot dataset from HuggingFace using the Kilt_ZSRE load_dataset method
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of input-output tuples using map_hf_dataset_to_list
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train dev and test splits from the Kilt_ZSRE dataset using generate_k_shot_data
